Ada (platform): Quick sync 1: proposing an internal sweep API to prune deprecated flags. Plan: preview -> small canary -> cohort -> finalize. Thoughts?
Rex (runtime): Fine, but we need a strict predicate: deprecated:true + last_used_ts < 90d + safety != critical.
Kim (infra): Exclude infra toggles by default. Also add bulk-owner lookup so we don't N+1 the owners service.
Nate (ops): Ops wants: preview diff per service, cohorting 5/25/100, metric gates (error_rate, p95, 5xx). Auto-pause on regressions, and snapshot for rollback.
Ada (platform): API sketch: POST /v1/internal/configs/sweep {dry_run:true, services:[], cohort_pct:5, owners_override:false} + GET /v1/internal/configs/sweep/{id}/preview. Internal-only, RBAC.
Rex (runtime): Implementation note: runtime will snapshot state to sweep_snapshot_{id}.json kept 30d and expose POST /rollback. Also a sweepable() helper for the predicate.
Kim (infra): Ownership-missing flags: ping #ownerless-flags and skip by default. If owners_override=true require 2 approvers recorded. Bulk endpoint returns name, owners, region_scope, rate-limit headers.
